sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). The league leaders arrive in excellent form, with their last five results reading WIN-DRAW-WIN-WIN-WIN, and they will be heavily favoured against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once in their recent outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town at home, looking to maintain pressure on the leaders with their solid recent form of D-W-W-L-W-D. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash; AFC Bridgnorth have bounced back from a recent loss with strong form overall (L-W-W-W-W-W), while Eccleshall (L-W-W-W-W-L) will need to steady themselves after back-to-back losses. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home—the visitors are in mixed form (W-L-W-L-L-W) while Casuals have been largely positive (W-W-D-W-L-W). Bilston Town, in sixth place with impressive recent form (W-W-D-W-D-W), host Foley Meir in a clash between mid-table sides. Barnton entertain Shawbury United; Barnton's recent record shows W-L-W-D-W-D while Shawbury are struggling (L-L-L-L-L-W) and will be seeking an escape from the drop zone. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table encounter, with Crewe (L-L-W-W-L-L) facing an Allscott side showing signs of improvement (W-W-L-L-W-D). Market Drayton Town, winless in recent outings (L-W-W-W-L-L), visit New Mills, who have also struggled lately (L-L-D-L-W-D). Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-area battle, both sides in poor recent form (Nomads D-D-L-L-L-W, Telford L-L-L-L-D-D). Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town; Widnes sit bottom with just 2 points and are winless in their last six, while Brereton (W-L-D-L-L-D) will look to make the most of a home fixture against the league's weakest side.
